messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Claims are being assigned to the motor team in a way that doesn't align with their workload or postcode zones.
  quote: we’ve been having some issues with how claims are assigned in our motor team — it’s not matching our workload or postcode zones.
- problem: The team needs both automatic claim routing by postcode and workload, and manual routing control for complex cases, but the system lacks configurable per‑team routing options.
  quote: Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing. We need manual claim routing options configurable per team.
- problem: The commercial claims team must manually route claims because automatic assignment mishandles complex cases.
  quote: Also, our commercial claims team needs manual claim routing — auto-assignment breaks our complex cases.
- problem: Commercial claims are too complex to be automatically routed.
  quote: Our commercial claims are too complex for auto-routing — we need manual claim routing for those, while motor claims can stay automated by postcode and workload.
- problem: The platform forces a single claim routing approach, but the commercial team needs a different, manual process.
  quote: We don’t want to force one approach across all teams... Per-team configuration would solve it... prefers manual claim routing — one-size-fits-all doesn’t work for us.
- problem: Claims handlers find the system's auto‑routing unhelpful for complex commercial and specialty files.
  quote: Our commercial and specialty claims handlers find auto-routing unhelpful — we need manual claim routing to manage complex files properly, especially with multiple suppliers and policyholders involved.
- problem: Manual claim routing slows down the high-volume motor team.
  quote: Our motor team handles high-volume cases and wants automatic assignment based on postcode and workload... manual claim routing slows them down too much.
- problem: The motor and commercial teams disagree on whether claim allocation should be automated or manually controlled for complex cases.
  quote: First, our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases.
